description: Send the game to the Steam Deck paired with this computer and put it in the Deck's library as "Devkit Game: <id>": runs the build (Godot Linux export, Unity Linux64, Unreal, a web build, or the project's own command), checks it is something the Deck runs (Linux x86-64, or Windows x64 through Proton), copies only what changed, and optionally starts it. Reads glitchless.deck.json in the project (glitchless-deck init writes one). Needs the Deck awake on this network and paired once with `glitchless-deck pair`, which the user approves on the Deck.

build.description: Run the build first (default true); false sends what is already built

game.description: Game id from glitchless.deck.json (optional when the project has one game)

glitchless.description: Start it with --glitchless --glitchless-intake=http://<this computer>:7777 so it reports to the local Glitchless server

intake.description: Report to this Glitchless server instead (a URL the Deck can reach)

launch.description: Start the game on the Deck once it is there

project.description: Folder with the glitchless.deck.json (default: the folder the agent works in)

name: glitchless_deck_send
title: Send to Steam Deck
